messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] Elevated p99 latency and increased 5xx/timeouts on hosted-api /v1/generate (canary). Error rate +9% in last 3m. Canary deploy runtime-v3.8.1 started ~4924680000. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/4924

Sarah: seeing it too — p95 jumped 1.8s -> 6.2s, p99 18s -> 45s. 5xx rate ~11% on canary slice. Can confirm increased gateway timeouts.

Dmitri: digging logs from model-hosts-canary-*. Lots of: "write: connection reset by peer" and many connection-retry backoffs. KV cache miss rate spiking during warmup. Repro with local stress harness. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T21:05:12Z] model-hosts-canary-3 write: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-17T21:05:13Z] kvcache: miss rate 0.82 -> 0.95
```

Maya: I'm oncall. Initiating immediate mitigation plan: rollback canary -> previous runtime, plus temporary route shift if rollback slow. Will run rollback now. /deploy rollback canary runtime-v3.8.1 -> runtime-v3.8.0 :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Rollback job started: #deploy-4924681357-rollback. Progress: 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

Sarah: while rollback runs, suggest: 1) shift production traffic away from canary model-variant to redwood-base-1 in us-west, 2) bump gateway timeout to 60s for in-flight requests to avoid cascading retries.

Jeff: support notes — 6 customer errors filed in last 10m (tickets #SUP-5632, #SUP-5633...). No major SLA escalations yet, but threshold near breaching for paid tiers. Posting quick update to status.redwood.com.

Dmitri: quick hypothesis — new multiplexing kernel flag (mux_write_opt=true) in runtime-v3.8.1 interacts poorly with our connection pool during kv warmup. Found config diff: 
```
- mux_write_opt=false
+ mux_write_opt=true
```
Stress reproduces socket starvation under bursty canary traffic.

Maya: rollback completed at 4924681450. Confirming canary back to runtime-v3.8.0 and canary traffic dropped to 0%. Observability: p99 trending back to baseline within 90s.

IncidentBot: [RESOLVED] Rollback finished, error rates and p99 latency returned to normal windows. Incident duration ~14m. Postmortem ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4924

Sarah: notes for postmortem: 1) add kvcache warmup gating to canary rollout (block traffic until kv hit rate >80%), 2) add deploy-time gating for mux_write_opt flips, 3) add synthetic canary warmup test.

Nora: I'll open the incident doc and assign owners: eng-runtime (Dmitri), eng-ml (Sarah), SRE (Maya). Adding runbook link and paging timeline.

Maya: leaving handoff to on-call rotation. Monitoring for 30m, will escalate if any regression. :eyes:

Jeff: thanks all — sending brief to comms and support to update customers. :thumbsup:
